hero.title: Empowering the Next Generation of Healthcare Leaders
hero.subtitle: Pharma4Ghana is a Dutch foundation dedicated to supporting pharmacy and health science students across Ghana with scholarships, mentorship, and resources.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: We believe every talented student deserves access to quality education. Pharma4Ghana bridges the gap between ambition and opportunity for students in pharmaceutical sciences and healthcare across Ghana.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.body:
A future in which every student with talent and motivation has the opportunity to complete training as a pharmacy assistant. Through structured collaboration between professionals in Ghana and the Netherlands, Stichting Pharma4Ghana is building sustainable knowledge transfer and local support.
Stichting Pharma4Ghana does not view this international collaboration as temporary aid, but as a partnership founded on equality, respect, and long-term impact.

impact.title: How We Make an Impact
impact.subtitle: The pillars that define our approach to supporting pharmaceutical education, students and teachers in Ghana.

scholarship.title: Scholarships
scholarship.body: Providing financial support to outstanding pharmacy and health science students at Ghanaian universities, covering tuition, books, and living expenses.

mentorship.title: Mentorship
mentorship.body: Connecting Ghanaian students with experienced pharmacists and healthcare professionals in the Netherlands and Ghana for career guidance.

resources.title: Resources
resources.body: Donating textbooks, laboratory equipment, and digital learning tools to pharmacy faculties across Ghana.

exchange.title: Students exchange
exchange.body: A students exchange programme in collaboration with Rijksuniversiteit Groningen.

cta.title: Make a Difference Today
cta.body: Your contribution enables the next generation of pharmacists and healthcare workers in Ghana to reach their full potential.

hero.title: About Pharma4Ghana
hero.subtitle: A foundation built on the belief that education is the most powerful tool for transforming lives.

story.title: Our Story
story.para1: Stichting Pharma4Ghana was founded in 2026 by four Dutch pharmacists. Our shared passion for pharmacy and our drive to contribute to education in Ghana brought us together. What began as a modest initiative to provide financial support to a handful of students has grown into a foundation that makes a fundamental contribution to educational opportunities for the pharmaceutical care professionals of the future.
story.para2: We work together with the Health Access Institute in Accra, an educational institution that trains pharmacy assistants. Together, we strengthen this education.

education.title: Practice-Oriented Education
education.body: Education that aligns with practical experience. For example, case-based lessons and project-based learning, complementing theoretical knowledge. We strive to ensure that students are optimally prepared for their roles in healthcare.

sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.body: Focus on long-term impact. We work closely with local educational and healthcare institutions to ensure that we create sustainable and meaningful changes.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Education for every student. We believe that every motivated student should have the same opportunities. As graduated healthcare professionals, they contribute to their communities and the healthcare system in Ghana.

partnership.title: Partnership
partnership.body: Collaborating based on respect and trust. We prioritize local values and work together to achieve common goals.

team.title: Our Team
team.subtitle: Dedicated pharmacists from the Netherlands, united by a passion for education.

governance.title: Our Governance
governance.subtitle: Dedicated pharmacists from the Netherlands, united by a passion for education.
governance.general:
The board of the Pharma4Ghana Foundation consists of four people.
The foundation raises funds through donations from individuals and companies, grants, initiatives, campaigns, gifts, and legacies.
The foundation's assets are managed by the board and used exclusively to achieve its objectives.
governance.finance:
Funds are spent on scholarships for students and direct support for educational activities in Ghana.
Organizational costs, such as administration and logistics, are kept to a minimum. Board members receive no remuneration for their work. Reimbursement is possible only for expenses incurred.

meta.title: Meet Ghana
meta.description: Discover Ghana, our educational partner in Accra, and the people at the heart of Pharma4Ghana's work.

hero.title: Meet Ghana
hero.subtitle: A country of warm hospitality, rich traditions and ambitious young people shaping the future of healthcare.
hero.imageAlt: Green Ghanaian landscape beneath a wide blue sky

intro.title: A strong country with a generous spirit
intro.paragraph1: Ghana lies on the Gulf of Guinea in West Africa, between Côte d'Ivoire, Burkina Faso and Togo. From its Atlantic coastline and tropical forests to the lively streets of Accra, the country brings together striking landscapes, many languages and a rich cultural heritage.
intro.paragraph2: Ghana is known for its hospitality, democratic tradition and energetic communities. Education, entrepreneurship and a strong sense of responsibility toward family and society are important strengths. That combination of openness and ambition makes Ghana a natural place for long-term educational partnerships.

partner.label: Our partner in Accra
partner.name: Health Access Institute
partner.body: HAI trains pharmacy assistants with a strong focus on practical skills. Together, we connect local experience with educational support from the Netherlands.

profiles.title: Meet the people
profiles.subtitle: Perspectives on education, collaboration and the opportunities we want to build together.

director.label: Meet the director
director.title: Dr. Charles Allotey
director.body: As director and founder of HAI, dr. Charles Allotey is committed to increasing access to practical and scientific education, thereby strengthening healthcare in Ghana. His ambition is to offer more programs and train more people who can support the healthcare system. Although the need for well-trained healthcare professionals is great, obtaining sufficient resources and facilities for practical education remains a significant challenge.
director.testimonial: Pharma4Ghana is a unique initiative, precisely because it originated from the experiences of people who encountered the Ghanaian healthcare system during their own studies. It is important that this involvement continues and that the collaboration is maintained.

administrator.label: Meet the staff member
administrator.title: Roselyn Owusu
administrator.body: Roselyn Owusu works as an administrative staff member at HAI. Her goal is to create the most optimal environment for students, teachers and everyone involved. She particularly values the interaction between students and teachers, not only during lessons but also beyond. This forms her ambition to make HAI one of the best educational institutions in Ghana. At the same time, the financial dependence on tuition fees poses a major challenge for her work. As a result, she must handle the available resources very carefully to create the best possible learning environment.
administrator.testimonial: Pharma4Ghana is a very valuable and interesting initiative that helps students alleviate financial pressure in a supportive way. This makes students more motivated and gives them more space to focus on their studies.

student.label: Meet a student
student.title: Danie
student.body: Danie is a first-year Pharmacy Technician student and chose HAI because the school is known for practical education provided by qualified teachers. In his environment, he has seen many people misuse medicines and suffer from conditions that could have been prevented. He wants to contribute by advising people properly, dispensing medicines safely, and thereby saving lives. He looks forward to learning about the preparation of medicines and advising patients.
student.testimonial: Pharma4Ghana stands for hope for Ghana. It contributes to the development of high-quality pharmaceutical care in Ghana.
student.imageCaption: Danie with exchange students Jasmijn and Jasmijn

exchangeStudents.label: Meet the exchange students
exchangeStudents.title: Jasmijn & Jasmijn
exchangeStudents.body: The exchange at HAI has given Jasmijn and Jasmijn the opportunity to actively contribute to the development of HAI and its education. They believe that good education forms the basis for quality healthcare and are therefore grateful to be able to contribute to this project. What particularly inspires them is the passion and involvement of the students, teachers, and the director. At the same time, they see that the limited availability of resources poses a challenge in providing education.
exchangeStudents.testimonial: Pharma4Ghana provides enormous support for HAI and is a valuable opportunity to exchange knowledge and experiences with passionate fellow students and teachers. This way, everyone learns from each other.
exchangeStudents.imageAlt: Jasmijn & Jasmijn in front of HAI classroom

student2.label: Meet a student
student2.title: Roy
student2.body: Roy is a first-year Pharmacy Technician student and chose this study after his mother was prescribed the wrong medication at the pharmacy. This had major consequences for her health and the family's financial situation. This inspired him to develop into a well-trained healthcare professional to help others and his mother. He is happy with this opportunity at HAI, where he is in an environment with people who share the same interests as him and where everyone can learn from each other. He experiences pressure from the many exams and the large amount of study material, but also from the financial burden of tuition fees.
student2.testimonial: Roy sees Pharma4Ghana as a valuable initiative that helps improve pharmaceutical education in Ghana and also provides motivated young people with financial challenges the opportunity to realize their dreams.

meta.title: Activities
meta.description: Explore Pharma4Ghana's grants, student exchanges, webinars, and practical support for pharmaceutical education in Ghana.

hero.title: Our Activities
hero.subtitle: Four connected programmes that turn partnership into practical opportunities for students and educators in Ghana.

grant.title: Grant
body: Our Educational Grant helps motivated pharmacy students continue their training when tuition costs would otherwise prevent them from completing their studies.
Candidates are selected with our local education partners based on motivation, academic progress, and financial need. This keeps support transparent and close to the students who benefit from it.
grant.imageAlt: Graduating pharmacy students celebrating together in Ghana

exchange.title: Student Exchange
body: We are developing student exchange opportunities with academic partners in Ghana and the Netherlands. These placements connect classroom knowledge with day-to-day pharmaceutical practice.
The programme is designed as a mutual exchange: students learn from another healthcare setting, share professional perspectives, and bring that experience back to their own institutions.

webinars.title: Webinars
body: Online sessions make specialist knowledge accessible across distance. Pharmacists, lecturers, and other healthcare professionals share practical expertise with students and teaching staff.
Topics are selected together with our Ghanaian partners so each webinar responds to current educational needs and can be applied directly in the classroom or workplace.
If you wish to contribute to the webinars programme, please contact us for more information.

support.title: Support
body: We support pharmaceutical education with textbooks, professional literature, learning tools, and practical materials that are difficult to access locally.
Support is coordinated with partner institutions to ensure every contribution is useful, sustainable, and suited to the curriculum.
support.imageAlt: Pharmaceutical reference books and study materials
